# Invented windows for the custom GUI tests (#136). Ids are made up.
scripted_gui = {
	SWE_reform_opener = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "swe_opener_window"
		visible = { tag = SWE }
		effects = {
			swe_open_click = {
				set_country_flag = swe_reform_open
				swe_refresh_gui = yes
			}
		}
	}

	SWE_reform_window = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "swe_reform_window"
		visible = { has_country_flag = swe_reform_open }
		dynamic_lists = {
			swe_row_grid = { array = swe_rows entry_container = swe_row_entry }
		}
		effects = {
			swe_fund_click = {
				add_political_power = -25
				set_country_flag = swe_funded
			}
			swe_fund_right_click = {
				clr_country_flag = swe_funded
			}
			swe_decree_click = {
				set_global_flag = swe_decree_for_everyone
			}
			swe_helper_click = {
				swe_reach_everyone = yes
			}
			swe_states_click = {
				every_owned_state = { limit = { is_owned_by = PREV } add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1 }
			}
			swe_prev_click = {
				PREV = { add_political_power = 1 }
			}
			swe_row_click = {
				set_variable = { swe_pick = v }
			}
		}
		triggers = {
			swe_fund_click_enabled = { has_political_power > 30 }
			swe_row_click_enabled = { check_variable = { v > 0 } }
		}
		ai_enabled = { tag = SWE }
		ai_weights = {
			swe_fund_click = {
				ai_will_do = { base = 5 }
			}
		}
	}

	SWE_state_window = {
		context_type = selected_state_context
		window_name = "swe_state_window"
		effects = {
			swe_state_click = { add_political_power = 1 }
		}
	}
}
